units.source_text: 他们竟然丝毫也没有留意到他们自己身边站着一个未来的犯人，

en.t: They had not noticed at all that a future criminal was standing right beside them,

units.source_text: 这个未来的犯人佯装若无其事的样子，

en.t: and this future criminal, pretending that nothing was the matter,
reached his hand toward the brazier.

units.source_text: 性格爽朗的年轻姑务员大声吹嘘他下个假日将去看的电影。

en.t: The cheerful young attendant loudly boasted about the movie he was going to see on his next day off.

units.source_text: 那是一部精彩的、催人泪下的电影，也不乏花哨的武打场面。

en.t: It was a splendid, tearjerking movie, and it also had plenty of flashy fight scenes.
On his next day off, he would go to see a movie!

units.source_text: 这个朝气蓬勃的、远比我魁伟的、生动活泼的青年在下个假日将去看电影，

en.t: This energetic, lively young man, far more imposing than I was, would go to see a movie on his next day off,

units.source_text: 拥抱女人，然后进入梦乡。

en.t: embrace a woman, and then drift into sleep.
